description:
## What

Define `pkix_aia::AiaError` enum per the cache-friendliness MUSTs in PKIX-zkjb description (constraint 2):

- `#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]`
- `#[non_exhaustive]`
- `Send + Sync` (auto-derived; assert via static_assertions in tests)
- `#[cfg_attr(feature = "serde", derive(serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize))]`
- NO embedded `std::io::Error` — use `IoFailure { kind: io::ErrorKind, message: String }` per PKIX-2l0v.1 D3
- Use workspace serde wire-form convention (format-adaptive via serde_with) per memory `pkix-serde-wire-form-2026-05-13`

## Variants (initial sketch — refine during impl)

- `FetchingDisabled` — emitted by NoAiaFetcher default
- `IoFailure { kind: io::ErrorKind, message: String }` — transport error from HTTP fetcher
- `HttpStatus(u16)` — non-2xx response
- `ResponseTooLarge { limit: usize, actual: usize }` — adapter-side size cap exceeded
- `MalformedCertificate(String)` — fetched bytes do not parse as a Certificate
- `Timeout` — fetch timed out
- `UriUnsupported(String)` — non-http(s) AIA URI (e.g., ldap://) when the fetcher only handles HTTP

Document semantics: AiaError is the "fetch failed" signal. The caller's chain-validation layer translates AiaError into a chain-build failure (typically "could not retrieve missing intermediate").

## Acceptance

- [ ] `pkix_aia::AiaError` enum defined with all derives per constraint 2
- [ ] static_assertions for `Send + Sync` in tests
- [ ] Round-trip JSON serialize/deserialize test (when serde feature enabled)
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry on pkix-aia

## Out of scope

- Translation from AiaError to pkix-chain Error variant (that lives in PKIX-zkjb.6 verify_chain integration)
- HTTP-specific error mapping (that lives in PKIX-zkjb.5 pkix-aia-http)

## Cross-references

- PKIX-zkjb (parent)
- PKIX-2l0v.1 (D3 io::Error decision)
- Memory `pkix-serde-wire-form-2026-05-13`
- Memory `pkix-caching-batch-prevalidation-2026-05-12`
title: Define AiaError type in pkix-aia per non-negotiable #6 constraints
